summary.text: Seamus O'Toole, who ran in New Jersey's 7th Congressional District on the "Stop Israel's Genocide Party" ballot line, lost the November 3, 2026 election to Rebecca Bennett, receiving 1.5% of the vote to Bennett's 57.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
